content:
- Completed improve-code-boundaries smell-5 cleanup: kept HA observer/write-convergence conninfo typed as PgConnInfo instead of raw DSN strings until the final connection/probe edge.
- Added canonical PgConnInfo.hostaddr support with parser/renderer coverage and updated explicit src/ constructors to set hostaddr: None.
- Refactored tests/ha/support/observer/pgtm.rs to construct canonical observer conninfo, changed PostgresRoutingTarget to carry PgConnInfo, and updated HA step probes to render only at the psql boundary.
- Refactored write-convergence invariant helpers to use typed conninfo/TLS fields instead of reparsing strings; adjusted the local real-postgres fixture DSN to emit canonical sslmode=disable for the typed parse path.
- Verification passed: make lint succeeded; make test succeeded after cleaning stale package build artifacts that caused intermittent missing-object linker failures in incremental test builds.
- Committed and pushed: e5ad2fe (Keep HA conninfo typed through observer boundary).
- Left unrelated pre-existing dirty worktree changes untouched in src/process/worker.rs, tests/ha/support/timeouts/mod.rs, and some .ralph files not part of this commit.
- Next after task switch: pick the next task with awareness that cargo-nextest focused reruns can hit intermittent stale incremental artifact linker failures; cargo clean -p pgtuskmaster_rust --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu cleared it when needed.
